cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: No new filing or release on 2026-10-06 (latest EDGAR item is the 2026-09-24 6-K); the -11.8% by 15:05 ET on 1.23x volume, 90% intraday, is the continuation of a death-spiral after a $5.0m registered direct at $0.21 with Series A/B warrants (closed 2026-09-21) whose exercise prices reset to the lowest daily VWAP of a window around the 160-for-1 consolidation effective 2026-09-28, with aggregate exercise price held constant so share counts balloon against ~2.35m post-split shares.

evidence.claim: Registered direct: 23,809,530 shares at $0.21 with Series A ($0.44, 5y) and Series B unit warrants ($0.21, 30 days), Maxim placement agent, closed 2026-09-21; 375,387,811 shares after

160-for-1 consolidation effective 2026-09-28, ~2,346,174 Class A shares after; Series A/B exercise price reset to lowest daily VWAP from five trading days before to five trading days after the effective date; share count may exceed proportional adjustment
Series B and Series A warrants hold aggregate exercise price constant on a share combination; Series B expires 30 days from issuance; no alternative/zero-price cashless exercise
No filing after 2026-09-24 in the issuer's submissions feed

pipeline.next_dated_event: Series B unit warrants expire ~2026-10-21 (30 days from 2026-09-21 issuance), which is also when the company's 30-day issuance standstill lapses; nothing dated inside the window
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A 6-K tonight announcing a new financing (would contradict the standstill reading) or warrant exercises/sales, or a price above ~$3.4 at which the reset warrants come into the money.

positioning_check: Short interest 126,637 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement (pre-split, ~790 post-split), 1.06 days to cover, +99% vs 08-31; published with ~8 business-day lag and predates the 160:1 consolidation, so positioning into this fall is unobservable and immaterial in size (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/DCX/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). Insider: no Form 4 activity in 3 months per Nasdaq; CEO bought 41,000 pre-split shares at $1.25 on 2026-07-31. No options market, no skew.

findings.finding: The warrant reset window closed at the 2026-10-05 close (fifth trading day after the 2026-09-28 consolidation), so warrant holders' incentive to depress the daily VWAP that sets their exercise price is spent and dated.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The seller-that-set-the-price is finished and dated: reset period per Series A warrant §3(b) and the 2026-09-24 6-K ended 2026-10-05; from 2026-10-06 holders are long fixed-strike warrants (~$3.4, estimated from the 10-05 bar 3.18-3.90, close 3.38) and benefit from a higher price, not a lower one.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior reset expiry for this name; today (first session after the window closed) still fell 11.8% on 1.23x volume, which argues the reset-gaming seller was not the only seller.
findings.why_not_priced: If the tape had registered that the reset-driven selling ended, 10-06 would have stabilised; it fell 11.8% instead, so either other sellers remain or the change has not been read. Sized small because today's tape is partial evidence against it.
findings.independence: Warrant text itself: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1957413/000149315226043615/ex4-1.htm (Series A §3(b), five trading days before through fifth trading day after the Share Combination Event Date).

findings.finding: Reset warrant overhang caps any rebound: Series B (~$5.0m aggregate at ~$3.4 = ~1.47m units, each a share plus a Series A warrant, expiring ~2026-10-21) and Series A (~$10.5m aggregate = ~3.1m shares) against ~2.35m shares outstanding become exercisable-and-sellable above ~$3.4, about 14% over spot.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Exercise and sale can happen any session the price trades above the reset; Series B holders face a ~2026-10-21 expiry so they exercise into the first strength, which lands inside the window if a bounce of >14% occurs.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the 2026-09-21 deal the name has risen on 2 of 12 qualifying next sessions (+37.5% on 09-17, +2.8% on 09-30); the stock is -98% over 60 sessions.
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang is public, but it acts as a ceiling on the right tail of tomorrow's distribution rather than a level; a price that held it would show bounces failing near $3.4, which is not yet observable because the reset is newly set. The reset level is my estimate from the 10-05 bar, not a published number.
findings.independence: Share count and consolidation from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1957413/000149315226044083/form6-k.htm; offering size from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1957413/000149315226043493/form424b5.htm

findings.finding: The 2026-09-18 securities purchase agreement bars the company from issuing new securities for 30 days after the 2026-09-21 closing, so a fresh offering cannot price tonight or tomorrow.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The standstill runs to ~2026-10-21, covering the whole window; it removes the commonest second shoe (an overnight offering) for this serial issuer (424B5s on 2025-10-02, 2025-11-25, 2026-09-21).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Each prior financing coincided with sharp falls (09-18 -69.8% the day the SPA was announced).
findings.why_not_priced: A price holding a live offering risk would carry a further discount; with issuance contractually blocked, that risk is absent in the window. Small because warrant exercises are typically exempt and the market may not have discounted a new deal anyway.

outside_window.finding: Series B unit warrants expire ~2026-10-21 and the company's 30-day issuance standstill lapses about the same day; a new financing becomes possible after that, and the 90-day insider lock-up runs to ~2026-12-20.

Two consolidations within a year (12-for-1 in January 2026, 160-for-1 effective 2026-09-28) put the cumulative ratio above Nasdaq's 250 threshold, so a renewed sub-$1 bid would bring a delisting determination without a compliance period; spot is $2.98, so not reachable inside the window.
